definition: Counterfactual trajectories of the pooled stability-constrained tvNAR(1) at tau=1 from the country's last observed standardized state y_T: baseline_h = A^h y_T; shocked_h = baseline_h + A^h s_j, with s_j a one-standard-deviation shock to node j. The response A^h s_j is identical for every country (linearity); country differences, including in the L2 norm, arise from y_T — the projection of an invariant response onto the country's own state. The baseline is the linear companion's path, decaying toward the panel mean because stationarity was imposed; it is not the validated NAVAR forecast. Units standardized.
